claims.quote: Acid Sphingomyelinase Deficiency (ASMD) type B is a rare lysosomal disorder caused by SMPD1 mutations.
Due to its low prevalence and clinical heterogeneity, diagnosis is challenging, and detection is crucial for the initiation of enzyme replacement therapy.
